newsitem.title: USA: Steven Madden to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Steven Madden to buy back shares.

text.p: Steven Madden Ltd said Monday its board authorized the company to buy back up to 500,000 common shares over the next 18 months.
The shares will be held as treasury shares and may be used in connection with the company's stock option program and for other general corporate purposes, including acquisitions.

"The repurchase program reflects the board of directors' opinion that the present share price of Steve Madden Ltd is undervalued as compared with other footwear companies," the company said in a statement.
The company said share repurchases will be funded from existing cash, internally generated funds or through short-term debt.
